summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the new 'Recorrente' medication toggle, non-recurring date, agenda filtering and new grouped history endpoint. Backend 23/24 pytest green (1 flaky appointment test under xdist loadscope, passes solo). Frontend mobile 390px flow fully works: toggle ON by default, hint changes, date field appears when OFF (defaults to today), recurring badge 'Todos os dias', non-recurring badge 'Dose única · DD/MM/AAAA', edit preserves state, Concluído produces green toast and history entry with Programado/Marcado + delay counter + caregiver name. Occurrence_key parsing bug from iter 1 is fixed.

minor.issue: Lockout counter keyed by first X-Forwarded-For hop may not accumulate reliably in preview env due to ingress IP rotation. Pre-existing, documented via xfail.

TestAppointments.test_crud intermittently returns 401 when run in parallel (loadscope). Passes 100% when run sequentially. Likely session-scoped fixture cross-contamination with cookie jars across workers, not a backend bug.

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — pass a <SheetDescription> or aria-describedby prop to improve a11y.

action_items: (Low) Add aria-describedby / SheetDescription to SheetDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Low) Investigate xdist flakiness in TestAppointments if parallel pytest is desired; harmless otherwise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_agenda uses `today - timedelta(days=30)` as the historical window for non-recurring overdue meds; this is also used as the lower bound for appointments. Matches spec (overdue up to 30 days).

patient_history: items with scheduled_at > now are filtered out for medications (`if item['scheduled_at'] <= now`), but if there's an existing audit_log for a future-scheduled dose it would still be surfaced via logs loop; low risk given typical UX.
MedicationIn.check_date silently nulls `date` when recurring=True — intentional per spec. Frontend already passes date=null in that case.
notifier.py skips non-recurring meds whose `date` != today — matches spec. OK.
patient_history default range is 30 days, max 365 — matches history-load-more incrementing by 30. OK.
test_credentials: Owner cauabeckler0@gmail.com / Velum@2026 used only for auth/me reads. Dynamic test_*@example.com caregivers created and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: test_* caregivers + TEST_ patients/meds/history created during tests, cleaned up via pymongo at end + explicit cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_velum_backend.py now include TestRecurringMeds covering: recurring default True + date nulled, non-recurring 422 w/o date, agenda shows recurring every day + non-recurring only on its date + overdue up to 30d + hides future, action rejects wrong date (400), history grouped shape {days:[{date,items:[{changes[]}]}], range_days}, history multi-tenant 404, legacy med without 'recurring' field behaves as recurring. Server clock is Oct 2026 in preview env; test timezone defaults to America/Sao_Paulo. The occurrence_key bug (split(':') vs split(':',3)) from iter 1 is confirmed fixed on live backend.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iter-1 bugs fixed and new feature verified end-to-end.
